seo.title: Thank you: application received
seo.description: Your application has reached the Calwebtech careers inbox. Here is what happens next and how your details are handled.

title: Thanks. Your application is with us.
intro: Your details have gone to the careers inbox, which is kept apart from sales and marketing. We use what you send only to consider your application.

steps.title: A person reads it
steps.body: Every application is read by a person, not filtered out by keyword software.

steps.title: We get in touch about a match
steps.body: If your experience fits a role we are hiring for, we email you to arrange a first conversation.

steps.title: Your details stay in your control
steps.body: You can ask us to delete your application at any time through the contact page.

secondary.heading: See how we work
secondary.body: Read how our projects run, from discovery to handover, to get a feel for the day-to-day.
